ops.issue: Wrong reading of 何 in context: before the object particle を, 何 is read なに (なにを), not なん. なん is used before だ/で/と/の or counters. The kana transcribes 何を as なんを.
Token reading for 何 is なん, but before を the standard reading is なに. Teaches a wrong reading for a core N5 pattern (何を〜).
Romaji inherits the wrong reading of 何 (nan o instead of nani o).

before.jp: 何を話しているの？

structure_explanation.en: 何 (what) is the object, marked by を. The verb 話す (to talk) is in the 〜ている form (話している), which indicates an ongoing action ('to be talking'). The final particle の gives the tone of an informal/curious question. There is no relative clause here (verb + noun): the 〜ている is the final predicate of the sentence, not a modifier of a following noun.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: 何 (o quê) é o objeto, marcado por を. O verbo 話す (falar) está na forma 〜ている (話している), que indica ação em andamento ('estar falando'). A partícula の no fim dá o tom de pergunta informal/curiosa. Não há aqui oração relativa (verbo + substantivo): o 〜ている é o predicado final da frase, não um modificador de um substantivo seguinte.

structure_explanation.en: The target より appears in 私より ("than me"), reinforced by もっと ("even more"), comparing the degree of "エッチ" (naughty/perverted) of other people relative to the speaker. The first part 私よりもっとエッチな人もいて describes the existence of such people (with も = "also") and links by て to the result clause 安心しました ("I felt relieved"). Note how より + もっと together emphasize "even more than me".

A primeira parte 私よりもっとエッチな人もいて descreve a existência dessas pessoas (com も = "também") e liga-se por て à oração de resultado 安心しました ("fiquei aliviado"). Note como より + もっと juntos enfatizam "ainda mais do que eu".

before.jp: 表に出ようか。
before.kana: ひょうにでようか。

structure_explanation.en: Short, casual sentence in the volitional + か pattern. 表に uses に to indicate the destination of the movement ('to the outside'). The verb 出る ('to go out') appears in the volitional form 出よう ('let's go out'), and the final particle か turns this into an invitation/suggestion: 〜ようか is equivalent to 'how about we...?' or 'shall we...?'. Here 表 has the sense of 'outside', and the sentence is usually an invitation to settle something (a fight, a talk) outside.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Frase curta e casual no padrão volitivo + か. 表に usa に para indicar o destino do movimento ('para fora'). O verbo 出る ('sair') aparece na forma volitiva 出よう ('vamos sair'), e a partícula final か transforma isso num convite/sugestão: 〜ようか equivale a 'que tal a gente...?' ou 'vamos...?'. Aqui 表 tem o sentido de 'lado de fora', e a frase costuma ser um convite para resolver algo (briga, conversa) fora.
